an4.197:11.1: evaṃ vutte mallikā devī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.197:11.2: sā nūnāhaṃ bhante aññāya jātiyā kodhanā ahosiṃ upāyāsabahulā
an4.197:11.3: appampi vuttā samānā abhisajjiṃ kuppiṃ byāpajjiṃ patitthīyiṃ kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsiṃ
an4.197:11.4: sāhaṃ bhante etarahi dubbaṇṇā dūrūpā supāpikā dassanāya
an4.197:12.1: sā nūnāhaṃ bhante aññāya jātiyā adāsiṃ samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ sāhaṃ bhante etarahi aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā
an4.197:13.1: sā nūnāhaṃ bhante aññāya jātiyā anissāmanakā ahosiṃ paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issiṃ na upadussiṃ na issaṃ bandhiṃ sāhaṃ bhante etarahi mahesakkhā
an4.197:13.2: santi kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññāpi brāhmaṇakaññāpi gahapatikaññāpi tāsāhaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ kāremi
an4.197:13.3: esāhaṃ bhante ajjatagge akkodhanā bhavissāmi anupāyāsabahulā
an4.197:13.4: bahumpi vuttā samānā nābhisajjissāmi na kuppissāmi na byāpajjissāmi na patitthīyissāmi na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissāmi
an4.197:13.5: dassāmi samaṇassa brāhmaṇassa annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ
an4.197:13.6: anissāmanakā bhavissāmi paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na ississāmi na upadussissāmi na issaṃ bandhissāmi
an4.197:13.7: abhikkantaṃ bhante …pe… upāsikaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
